SELECT 'STG_EDS_GLD_TRANDETAIL', COUNT(*), CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS_OF_DATE FROM D360.STG_EDS_GLD_TRANDETAIL WHERE H='D' GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'GLD_TRANDETAIL',COUNT(*),AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.GLD_TRANDETAIL GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE

SELECT * FROM EDS.GLD_TRANDETAIL
